restrictions: Fixed-IV SHA-256, first 40 steps, standard padding and feed-forward, equality of all 256 output bits; one 64-byte block per message from the standard IV.

Prices: one 40-step target compression is one unit; every other primitive word operation is 1/C with C = 2896. The 2 verification compressions of a found pair are charged as one unit each (2 units per found pair), separately from the word operations.

Head (proof Section 2): v7 generator (bit-sliced on 256 lanes; a gate on 256 lanes counts as one word operation, the accounting of the board's R40 entry df1f1cd1), 176 counted operations per kept pair (2^-4.04 units, measured run: 3,498 kept lanes), hard operation cap, pair-output path with 2 verification compressions; full 40-word schedule control on every kept pair.

Landing and tail (proof Section 3): the J26 difference lands on the target with probability 2^-256 per pair (premise P1, uniform junction, checked on 2^36 head-induced states to 32 bits); from the target the pair collides after step 40 with probability 1 (premise P2, 5000/5000 on head-induced states, negative control 0/2000).
Ledger: N = ln(1/0.61) x 2^256 pairs; T = N x 2^-4.04 + 2 x (found pairs); log2 T = 250.94304 (exact 250.94303381, rounded up).
Memory by construction: list subsets 357,408 bytes (2^18.45); preprocessing: list construction 2^28.2 compressions + 422 compressions of subset selection.
Premises P1, P2, P3 (independence across pairs) are declared heuristics of the exploratory lane (proof Section 6).

heuristics.statement: For pairs output by the v5 generator, the 256-bit J26 XOR difference equals the J26 target with probability 2^-256 per pair.
heuristics.scope: v5 generator pairs, standard IV, 40 steps
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured k-bit landing on 2^36 head-induced states: 2^-8.00, 2^-16.00, 2^-23.98, 2^-31.83 for k = 8, 16, 24, 32; per-bit |p-0.5| <= 0.00001; extended to 256 bits under independence of bits. The shipped program over 20,000 organizer-format trials (4,331,098 pairs): k=8 landing 16,883 (expected 16,918.4), k=16 landing 82 (expected 66.1); per-trial k=8 dispersion chi-square 20,067 vs 19,999 +- 200.
heuristics.limitations: Bits beyond 32 are not measured jointly.

heuristics.statement: A v5 pair whose J26 difference equals the target collides after step 40 with probability 1.
heuristics.scope: v5 generator pairs at the J26 target
heuristics.extrapolation: 5000/5000 on head-induced states with the target forced; negative control 0/2000.
heuristics.limitations: Forced-target states, not naturally landed ones.

heuristics.statement: Landing events of distinct pairs are independent.
heuristics.scope: pairs within and across shared batches
heuristics.extrapolation: k=4 landing correlation within batches -0.0009, across -0.0010, noise 0.0022 (8,192 pairs; 64-batch table in evidence). v7c (batch shares steps 0..12): chi-square independence test 259.3 vs 256 +- 22.6 (control 252.4), research junc7c.py. Over-dispersion test (research junc7c.py --k8): 64 batches x 512 pairs, per-batch k=8 J26 landing counts mean 2.094 (expected 2.000), variance 2.055 (Poisson 2.000), dispersion chi-square 65.0 on 64 batches (expected 64 +- 11.3): landings are Poisson across batches, no within-batch clustering. v7e (W13 = r + k x 6A09E667 per lane): GPU dispersion test vp7gpu.cu on 2^24-2^25 pairs per run, k=8 dispersion -0.52 sigma; all modes and seeds within +-2.2 sigma (research).
